name: Liquid Level Indicators For The 150LB/250LB, 375LB/560LB And 1200LB Cylinders

subcategory.name: Clean Agent Fire Extinguishing System Cylinders & Accessories

summary: The Liquid Level Indicator is a simple, manually operated device, which provides a means to determine the Clean Agent liquid level in a vertically mounted Context Plus Clean Agent filled Cylinder. Once the liquid level is determined, it can then be converted into the weight of Clean Agent present in the agent storage container.
description: When the liquid level is determined, the reading is then referred to a chart in the Context Plus Engineered Manual and the corresponding weight of Clean Agent is determined. Accurate readings can be obtained over a +400 F to +90 0 F temperature range.
